public_rationale: This is a conditional forecast: if OpenAI cannot meet its obligations, the market will feel ripples. I found no report of a default or failure to pay by OpenAI as of 28 October 2026, so the condition has not happened and the forecast cannot be scored. The April 2026 drop in Oracle, chip and neocloud shares came after a report of missed revenue targets, not a failure to pay. It is only context.
limitations: OpenAI is private, so a quiet renegotiation might not be visible.

our_interpretation: This is a conditional forecast. The antecedent is OpenAI failing to meet its obligations.
Plain reading of the consequent: noticeable market-wide effects, such as sharp falls in exposed companies like Oracle, chipmakers and neoclouds, or broader index moves following the failure.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI fails to meet its obligations, and exposed companies' stocks or credit, or broad markets, then show clear adverse moves tied to the failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI fails to meet its obligations, and markets and exposed companies show no meaningful reaction.
